name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) is weaker than the task. The task forbids opening the door only after dropping the key while it is closed; it does not forbid opening the door first and dropping the key later. Replace it with hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost), which permits key_lost only after the door has opened.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Precedence(door_open, key_lost) reverses the task’s requirement. The task says not to drop the key while the door is closed and open the door; it does not require opening the door before a key_lost event. Replace it with hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open), which forbids both events during the episode.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) captures the task’s ban on losing the key while the door is closed and opening the door during the episode.

texts: The key-lost event and opening the door must not both occur during the episode.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!key_lost) -> u2
(u0, door_open&key_lost) -> u3
(u1, door_open) -> u3
(u2, key_lost) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, door_open&key_lost, u3) -> -10
(u1, door_open, u3) -> -10
(u2, key_lost, u3) -> -10
